objective:
Goal: wikipedia's Book creator page is shown. Reach it from the current page by clicking through the visible UI, by any route. Never type a URL or use the address bar.
Hint: an old tutorial said "To do this, click Create a book under Print/export on the left sidebar in Wikipedia.", but those labels may have moved or been renamed.
When the goal is met, verify it on screen. If the page you end on has a main heading, store it as 'landed_on'; a page without a heading is fine.
